before: - **Older staged rates.** A building built or bought in its completion year under an old application or contract may be on the staged rates of § 7(5). Ask what past returns used; refer any change.
after: - **Older staged rates.** A building built or bought in its completion year under an application or contract before 1 January 2006 (housing; earlier dates for the other historic branches) may be on the staged rates of § 7(5). Ask what past returns used; refer any change.
